create_async_packager: create an AsyncPackager instance with a batch packaging function to queue and build Packageables
add_packageable_async: add a Packageable to the AsyncPackager batch and receive a picklable awaitable for the Executable result
trigger_package_batch: trigger the AsyncPackager to batch-package all queued Packageables and resolve their futures
package_with_extra: package queued and extra Packageables together synchronously via AsyncPackager.package()
handle_package_error: handle PackageHasNotBeenCalledError when awaiting a result before calling .package()
